Package com.stockroom.ui

Class ItemTableModel

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
com.stockroom.ui.ItemTableModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public class ItemTableModel extends AbstractTableModel
Table model that presents a list of Items as ledger rows.

Columns are No. (ledger line), ID, Item, Qty, Threshold and Status. The model is read-only; the inventory is changed through the entry slip, never by editing cells. The Qty column's value is the whole Item, so its renderer can draw the level bar from both quantity and threshold; sort it with a comparator on Item.getQuantity().
